# Task 042 shared NATO special-words conformance corpus.
#
# ONE canonical corpus drives the Rust, C++, and Ada generated validators.
#
# FORMAT (unchanged from Tasks 036-041; same loader, same escapes)
#   '#' begins a comment line; blank lines are ignored.
#   VALID <input> => <expected stored form>
#   INVALID <input>
# Exactly one space follows the VALID/INVALID keyword.
#   \s space   \t tab   \n line feed   \r carriage return   \\ backslash
#   \u{HEX} any code point
#   <empty> the EMPTY field, as a whole field only.
#
#   Some(text) = construction succeeded, stored value is exactly `text`
#   None       = rejected
#
# AUTHORITY
# Read verbatim from the pinned release bytes, byte-identical in both releases
# after end-of-line normalization:
#   UCI 2.5 093610b7753944059360d3236770ab446d039556
#           UCI_SecurityMarkings_v2_5_0.xsd:4903
#   UCI 2.6 78eb61b6112c8bffa40820c33124b57787fc5bd9
#           UCI_SecurityMarkings_v2_6_0.xsd:4916
#
#   <xs:restriction base="xs:string">
#     <xs:minLength value="6"/>
#     <xs:maxLength value="261"/>
#     <xs:pattern value="NATO:[a-zA-Z\-_]{1,256}"> (+ leading annotation)
#   </xs:restriction>
#
# No whiteSpace facet, so xs:string's intrinsic `preserve` applies: nothing is
# trimmed or collapsed, and every whitespace character is outside the class.
#
# TWO LENGTHS
# minLength/maxLength bound the TOTAL value (6..261). The quantifier {1,256}
# bounds the SUFFIX after the five-character prefix "NATO:". Total = 5 + suffix.
#
# THE SUFFIX CLASS
# [a-zA-Z\-_]: A-Z, a-z, HYPHEN, LOW LINE. In the schema expression `\-` is an
# XML Schema regex escape denoting HYPHEN. Constructor input is DECODED text, so
# a BACKSLASH in the input is simply a non-member and is rejected.
#
# SYNTHETIC VALUES
# Every VALID case below demonstrates grammar membership only. None is claimed
# to be a recognized real-world special word, and acceptance says nothing about
# a marking's meaning, authorization, or release policy.
#
# Boundary cases needing generated lengths (suffix 255/256/257, total 260/261/
# 262, long invalid inputs) live in each backend's probe, not here.

# --- VALID: minimal and representative suffixes ---
VALID NATO:A => NATO:A
VALID NATO:a => NATO:a
VALID NATO:Z => NATO:Z
VALID NATO:z => NATO:z
VALID NATO:- => NATO:-
VALID NATO:_ => NATO:_
VALID NATO:aBc-X_ => NATO:aBc-X_
# Suffix case is preserved exactly.
VALID NATO:ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ => NATO:ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ
VALID NATO:abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz => NATO:abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz
# Hyphen and underscore anywhere, including as the entire suffix.
VALID NATO:--- => NATO:---
VALID NATO:___ => NATO:___
VALID NATO:-_-_ => NATO:-_-_
VALID NATO:a-b_c => NATO:a-b_c
VALID NATO:-lead => NATO:-lead
VALID NATO:trail_ => NATO:trail_
# A second "NATO" and a letter after the prefix are ordinary suffix letters.
VALID NATO:NATO => NATO:NATO
VALID NATO:nato => NATO:nato

# --- INVALID: empty input and every truncated prefix (total 0..5) ---
INVALID <empty>
INVALID N
INVALID NA
INVALID NAT
INVALID NATO
# Bare prefix: total length 5, suffix length 0.
INVALID NATO:

# --- INVALID: wrong-case or misspelled prefix ---
INVALID nato:A
INVALID Nato:A
INVALID NAto:A
INVALID NATo:A
INVALID nATO:A
INVALID OTAN:A
INVALID NAT0:A
INVALID NATA:A
INVALID MATO:A
INVALID NBTO:A

# --- INVALID: missing, duplicated, or misplaced colon ---
INVALID NATOA
INVALID NATOAB
INVALID NATO::A
INVALID NATO;A
INVALID NATO.A
INVALID NAT:OA
INVALID :NATOA
INVALID NATO:A:B
INVALID NATO:A:

# --- INVALID: matching text preceded by extra characters ---
INVALID xNATO:A
INVALID _NATO:A
INVALID -NATO:A
INVALID NATO:NATO:A

# --- INVALID: whitespace, leading / trailing / interior ---
INVALID \sNATO:A
INVALID NATO:A\s
INVALID NATO:\sA
INVALID NATO:A\sB
INVALID NATO\s:A
INVALID NATO:A\t
INVALID \tNATO:A
INVALID NATO:A\tB
INVALID NATO:\s\s\s
# A valid-looking value followed by LF or CR, or CRLF.
INVALID NATO:A\n
INVALID NATO:A\r
INVALID NATO:A\r\n
INVALID \nNATO:A
INVALID NATO:A\nB

# --- INVALID: digits in the suffix ---
INVALID NATO:0
INVALID NATO:9
INVALID NATO:A1
INVALID NATO:1A
INVALID NATO:COSMIC2

# --- INVALID: punctuation outside the class ---
INVALID NATO:\\
INVALID NATO:A\\-B
INVALID NATO:\\-
INVALID NATO:/
INVALID NATO:A/B
INVALID NATO:[
INVALID NATO:]
INVALID NATO:[A]
INVALID NATO:^
INVALID NATO:`
INVALID NATO:@
INVALID NATO:{
INVALID NATO:|
INVALID NATO:~
INVALID NATO:.
INVALID NATO:+
INVALID NATO:*
INVALID NATO:'
INVALID NATO:"

# --- INVALID: NUL and other controls ---
INVALID NATO:\u{0}
INVALID NATO:A\u{0}
INVALID NATO:\u{0}A
INVALID NATO\u{0}:A
INVALID \u{0}NATO:A
INVALID NATO:\u{1}
INVALID NATO:\u{b}
INVALID NATO:\u{c}
INVALID NATO:\u{1b}
INVALID NATO:\u{1f}
INVALID NATO:\u{7f}
INVALID NATO:A\u{7f}

# --- INVALID: non-ASCII letters, lookalikes, multibyte characters ---
# Latin-1 letters.
INVALID NATO:\u{e9}
INVALID NATO:caf\u{e9}
INVALID NATO:\u{c0}
INVALID NATO:\u{df}
INVALID NATO:\u{ff}
# NO-BREAK SPACE and other non-ASCII spaces.
INVALID NATO:A\u{a0}
INVALID NATO:A\u{2028}B
INVALID NATO:A\u{3000}B
# Lookalikes: Cyrillic A (U+0410), Greek Alpha (U+0391), fullwidth A (U+FF21),
# fullwidth colon (U+FF1A), en dash (U+2013), non-breaking hyphen (U+2011).
INVALID NATO:\u{410}
INVALID NATO:\u{391}
INVALID NATO:\u{ff21}
INVALID NATO\u{ff1a}A
INVALID NATO:A\u{2013}B
INVALID NATO:A\u{2011}B
INVALID \u{39d}ATO:A
# CJK and a 4-byte emoji.
INVALID NATO:\u{5e74}
INVALID NATO:A\u{1f600}
